articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5 to ChatGPT Plus and Enterprise users, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single unified model, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show marked gains on PhD-level science QA and multi-step coding tasks, though independent evaluators note diminishing returns on common-sense reasoning compared to GPT-4o.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini Ultra 2 with a focus on agentic tool use, demonstrating the model autonomously completing multi-step workflows across web browsers, IDEs, and enterprise APIs. The system sets new records on the SWE-Bench and WebArena benchmarks, raising both excitement about autonomous AI agents and renewed discussion around safe deployment guardrails.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Herd with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released the Llama 4 family under a permissive open license, featuring a sparse mixture-of-experts design that delivers frontier-class performance while requiring roughly 40% less inference compute than dense equivalents. The release includes a 400B-parameter MoE flagship and distilled variants down to 8B, accelerating the open-source AI ecosystem and putting competitive pressure on proprietary API providers.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure announced the start of paid commercial operations with its Figure 03 humanoid robot at two BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina, marking one of the first revenue-generating deployments of a general-purpose humanoid. The robots are performing parts kitting, inspection, and bin-picking tasks alongside human workers, with BMW reporting a measurable throughput increase on target assembly lines.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Autonomous Construction-Site Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released footage showing its electric Atlas robot autonomously traversing an active construction site, climbing ladders, stepping over debris, and delivering tools to workers on elevated platforms. The demo leverages a new vision-language-action model trained on construction environments, suggesting a viable near-term commercial path beyond warehouse logistics.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm N2 Process with Gate-All-Around Transistors
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production at its Fab 20 in Hsinchu on the N2 node, the foundry's first process to use nanosheet gate-all-around transistors. The node promises 10-15% speed improvement and 25-30% power reduction over N3E, with Apple and NVIDIA expected among the first customers—a critical enabler for next-generation AI accelerators and mobile SoCs.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval to Expand Brain-Computer Interface Trial to 50 Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to implant its N1 brain-computer interface in up to 50 additional patients with paralysis, following positive 18-month safety and efficacy data from its initial cohort. Participants have demonstrated reliable cursor control and text entry at speeds approaching 40 words per minute, advancing the prospect of high-bandwidth neural interfaces for people with severe motor impairments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Harden Claude Against Jailbreak Attacks
articles.summary: Anthropic published a paper and deployed a new safety layer called Constitutional Classifiers across its Claude model family, which uses a hierarchy of lightweight classifier models to detect and refuse adversarial prompt injections in real time. Internal red-team results show a 90%+ reduction in successful jailbreaks compared to instruction-tuning-only defenses, sparking industry debate about whether competing labs will adopt similar architectures.
